tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Affidavit as per format in Annexure F
Annexure A Details of the Bidder
Annexure B Certificate of Turnover by CA
Annexure C Statement of Supplies Past Performance
Annexure D Format of Authorization letter from OEM to be submitted by the bidders in case of Authorized Dealers/distributors
Annexure E Service Centers in Karnataka
Annexure F Format of Affidavit/Undertaking.
Annexure G Format of General Power of Attorney
Appendix -1 Specifications, Scope of The Work, Functional & Technical Requirements
Appendix -2 Service Level Agreement
Appendix-6 KSMSCL account details for the payment of tender processing fees of Rs. 5900
Details of Service Centers in Karnataka and contract person for maintenance should be provided as per Annexure E
Earnest Money Deposit
GST Registration certification
GST remittance of the latest month

The bidder from such countries sharing a land border with India will be eligible to participate only if the bidder is registered with the Competent Authority as per the Directions of the Ministry of Finance, GOI.

The bidder should be the Original Equipment Manufacturer OEM or an authorized dealer of the OEM for supply of Equipment offered by them with supply experience of minimum 3 years to any of the Private Organization/ Government Department/Organization/Undertaking in the India
The Products offered by the bidder shall meet the specification as per Appendix I of the bid document

Towards financial capability, The bidder should have Average Annual turnover, as indicated at Section I -1, schedule of requirement against each of the equipment being offered by them, during preceding 3 years 2 years in case of state based MSME Units 2022-23,2023-24 and 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26

Towards past performance The bidder should have supplied, installed and commissioned satisfactorily the Equipment being offered them with the similar specification, functionality and complexity during any one financial year out of 3 years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25/ 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 either in single or multiple orders within India, as a percentage of the tendered requirement Quantity towards each of the equipment for which they have submitted the bid
